exposure: Pelvic surgery other than cesarean section
Endometrial thickness prior to embryo transfer
cohort: 225 ectopic pregnancy patients and 900 matched intrauterine pregnancy patients who underwent IVF-ET
finding: Endometrial thickness greater than 12 mm and a higher number of transferable embryos were found to be protective against ectopic pregnancy after IVF-ET, while tubal factor and pelvic surgery history increased the risk.
